idea: A reusable ralph-overview marketplace skill that imports an existing roadmap doc (ROADMAP.md headings/bullets, TODO/checkbox lists, markdown tables, or gh issues) into validated tracked tasks in .ralph-overview/data.json, reusing the createOnly mutation core; dedup ids vs hot+cold shards; confirm parsed set before write; cheapest first version (1-2 formats), defer rest.

candidateDirections.name: Skill-only single-format checkbox/heading importer reusing create-task path
candidateDirections.summary: New /import-roadmap skill parses one format (ROADMAP.md ## headings + - / - [ ] bullets) inline, assembles canonical create-task shapes, writes via overview.upsert_task createOnly + data-edit --create-only fallback; no new core code or dispatcher subcommand.

candidateDirections.name: Mandatory dry-run preview + editable proposed-tasks.json curate gate
candidateDirections.summary: Non-writing pass normalizes candidates, dedups vs hot+cold, emits exact createOnly ops to an editable proposed-tasks.json so operator prunes/edits scope + seeds prompts (kebab heading yields inert stubs without it) before any write.

candidateDirections.name: Idempotent fail-soft batch apply with manifest (skip-existing, continue)
candidateDirections.summary: No batch verb exists (runVerb = one task per lock/atomicWrite), so apply is N inserts: skip-existing, continue on per-item createOnly reject, print created/skipped/collided/invalid manifest, deterministic kebab makes re-run a no-op.

candidateDirections.name: Deterministic import-roadmap CLI + lib + thin skill wrapper
candidateDirections.summary: scripts/lib/import-roadmap.mjs + bin dispatcher subcommand + tests + machine dry-run; overbuilt for v1, defer until skill fragility is proven.

candidateDirections.name: GitHub issues + markdown tables deferred behind same canonical writer
candidateDirections.summary: Defer gh issues (auth/remote/pagination/rate-limit scope creep) and tables; accept only operator-supplied JSON export later if needed.

questionsForSynthesis: How often does a consumer have a parseable ROADMAP.md? If roadmaps are imported once, does this justify a SKILL vs a thin /create-task loop?
Imported stubs have no derivable prompts seeds; an editable proposed-tasks.json (D-002) is the curate gate that makes them trackable — confirm that gate is non-negotiable.
On mid-batch createOnly reject: skip-existing+continue (D-003) not abort — confirm idempotent deterministic-kebab re-run is acceptable.
v1 input format: ROADMAP.md heading+checkbox/bullet only, tables + gh issues deferred?
